description: Plan v7 section 8.3 clause "raw text 1.0 and GENDER_FEMININE remaining text while tagged forms dispatch", plain-interpolation half. One key with a single ordinary placeholder slot and no placeholder definitions, so the value never reaches a selector — StringInterpolator renders it directly (CharSequence appended verbatim, everything else via String.valueOf; verified against StringInterpolator.java). Single loaded locale so attemptedLocales is exactly [en] and no fallback policy is consulted. Verified by execution: the fixture builds and all eleven cases against it return TRANSLATED.
